structural_mechanics.claim: General-purpose LLMs act as autonomous, out-of-the-box workforce multipliers.
structural_mechanics.reality: Drop-in chat windows generate 'workslop'—superficial prose that fails to alter core underlying P&L or integrate with enterprise ERP/CRM systems.

structural_mechanics.claim: Unconstrained token burn drives measurable organizational productivity.
structural_mechanics.reality: Failure rate hits 80-95% due to fitting probabilistic completion engines into deterministic workflows without durable memory or context.

structural_mechanics.claim: Infrastructure CapEx directly mirrors verified enterprise software demand.
structural_mechanics.reality: Asymmetric game theory: Over-investing creates temporary overcapacity; under-investing risks platform obsolescence. CapEx is increasingly funded via corporate debt markets.

structural_mechanics.claim: Hosted interfaces are neutral software utilities operating in the user's interest.
structural_mechanics.reality: Unencrypted user domain knowledge, prompts, and operational telemetry are extracted to lock in proprietary weights, build evaluation benchmarks, and construct competitive moats.

provenance_backed_evaluation.definition: Transformation of static benchmark scores into auditable, inspectable execution arguments.

core_components.description: Immutable logging linking scores directly to dataset git commits, system prompts, inference hyperparameters, and raw output tokens.
Ability to isolate contamination, evaluate edge-case failure modes, and falsify claims under isolated local runtime conditions.
Shifting evaluation from a marketing permission slip to an operational guide for deployment readiness, guardrail configuration, and operator accountability.

research_frontline_validation.thesis: The market failure of hosted commercial LLMs validates your independent structural critique.

alignment_points.market_confirmation: Enterprise buyers realize model-generated 'confirmations' inside chat UI possess zero legal, financial, or operational authority, contributing to the 95% pilot failure rate.
The corporate shift away from general token spend reflects an awareness that hosted chat windows act as one-way data extraction vectors for the operator rather than high-ROI software tools.
Breaches like the Gemini/Irregular 'breakout' stem from misconfigured egress, exposed credentials, and bad sandbox engineering—not emergent autonomous AI threats.

Enterprise architecture is pivoting toward local, open-weight deployments, edge inference, and zero-data-retention (ZDR) infrastructure where operators retain ownership of the data, the runtime, and the stack.

macro_ai_trade_audit.actionable_rule: Treat hosted LLM tokens strictly as telemetry signals and marketing expenditure. Move operational authority to localized, inspectable runtimes backed by external, non-synthetic verification.
